subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar support persistent user-configured external command hooks as a first-class app and CLI feature?
rationale: Correctness review can validate the implementation, but it cannot decide whether CodexBar should permanently own a local command-execution API spanning shared config, UI, CLI, event semantics, and security guarantees.

options.title: Accept the hooks contract
options.body: Land the feature after the argv editor is corrected and focused round-trip and upgrade validation is supplied.

options.title: Narrow the initial surface
options.body: Start with a smaller CLI/config-only contract or fewer events and defer the settings UI or broader event API.

options.title: Decline external execution
options.body: Keep CodexBar limited to observability and built-in notifications rather than supporting user-configured process execution.

recommendation.title: Accept the hooks contract
recommendation.body: Land the feature after the argv editor is corrected and focused round-trip and upgrade validation is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the best available authority for accepting or declining this new permanent product and security boundary.
